wb = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)

def move_last_number_to_front(value):
    if value is None:
        return None

    text = str(value)
    matches = list(re.finditer(r"\d+", text))
    if not matches:
        return text

    last_match = matches[-1]
    last_number = last_match.group()
    preceding_text = text[:last_match.start()]
    following_text = text[last_match.end():]

    return last_number + preceding_text + following_text

for row in range(2, 5):
